content:
Zen5 = Ryzen 9000 series (Granite Ridge/Strix Point). AGESA pattern: CBS-STX/TUR/KRK.

Steps:
1. Scrape more AM5 boards (X870E, X870, B850 with newer BIOS): psp-etl scrape asus --socket am5 --limit 10
2. Also try ASRock AM5: psp-etl scrape asrock --socket am5 --limit 5
3. Ingest + analyze + select
4. Check if any entries classify as zen5
5. If yes: import richest per type into /zen5/ in Ghidra, apply types, transfer zen2/zen4 knowledge
6. Import coherent image into /zen5_coherent/
7. Update presentation slides with zen5 stats

Also update slide 8 (Key Findings) score distribution table to include zen4 data.
